data.name: Iram
data.gender_notes: Iram is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Iram refers to a city or an architect in Arabic. It symbolizes strength and grandeur. The name Iram carries the meaning “Architect or City” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Iram usually hope their child will grow to embody architect or city and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mentioned in the Quran as a city with tall buildings and pillars, Iram signifies greatness and prosperity.
data.etymology: Iram belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Architect or City.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iram total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: إرام
in_arabic.meaning: إرام اسم علم يعني الإبل السريعة أو الجبل العالي
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم إرام مشتق من الجذر اللغوي 'ر-و-م' الذي يحمل معاني السرعة والارتفاع، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفجر 'أَلَمْ تَرَكَ رَبُّكَ أَدًا وَإِيرَامًا'. يرمز الاسم للقوة والسرعة والارتفاع في المكانة

in_urdu.name: ارام
in_urdu.meaning: ارام کا مطلب ہے تیز رفتار یا بلند جبل
in_urdu.long_meaning: ارام نام عربی جذر 'ر-و-م' سے نکلا ہے جس کے معنی ہیں سرعت اور بلندی۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں مقبول ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے طاقت، سرعت، اور بلند مقام

in_hindi.name: इराम
in_hindi.meaning: इराम नाम का अर्थ है तेज गति या ऊंचा पहाड़
in_hindi.long_meaning: इराम नाम अरबी जड़ 'र-व-म' से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है गति और ऊंचाई। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में लोकप्रिय है और इसका अर्थ है शक्ति, गति और उच्च स्थान

in_pashto.name: ارام
in_pashto.meaning: ارام د چټکتیا یا لوړ غر معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: د ارام نوم د عربي ريښې 'ر-و-م' څخه اخستل شوی دی چې د چټکتیا او لوړوالي معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتنو په دود کې کارول کیږي او د قوت، چټکتیا، او لوړ مقام معنی لري

in_english.name: Iram
in_english.meaning: Iram means rapid or high mountain
in_english.long_meaning: The name Iram originates from the Arabic root 'ر-و-م' (R-W-M), which conveys meanings of speed and elevation. It is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Fajr. The name symbolizes strength, swiftness, and high status in Islamic tradition

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل: ای رام
pronunciation.hindi: हिन्दी में उच्चारण विवरण: ई राम
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: ارام

data.cultural_impact: Iram is believed to be a legendary city mentioned in several Arabic and Islamic texts. The city, known for its vast wealth and grand architectural designs, has been inspirationally referenced in numerous poems and folklores. It reflects the rich cultural history and architectural achievements of the Arabian Peninsula and has been a subject of intrigue and fascination for Islamic civilization for centuries.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, Iram represents a celestial paradise where the rivers flow unendingly, and its buildings have been fashioned out of gold, silver, and precious stones. It is a symbol of the eternal and beautiful abode promised to believers in the afterlife. The grandeur and beauty of this city are believed to reflect the infinite mercy and grace of God, and it serves as a constant reminder of the rewards that await those who remain steadfast on the path of faith.
